tools.description: Audit ANY URL for AI-search readiness only (AEO/GEO/LLMO) — how likely ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity & Google AI are to cite it. Checks ~7 AI-citation signals (FAQ/structured-data/entity schema, citable stats, llms.txt, author/E-E-A-T, OG). Returns a weighted 0–100 AI-readiness score + top fixes. Takes a `url`. Use full_seo_audit for the broader SEO picture, or get_my_store_audit for the user's own connected store.

url.description: The website URL to audit, e.g. https://example.com

tools.name: ai_search_diagnostic

tools.description: Crawl-audit ANY URL across the WHOLE SEO surface (no login needed): the AI-search signals PLUS on-page SEO (title/meta/headings/content), technical SEO (HTTPS, robots.txt, XML sitemap, canonical, mobile), and — for Shopify stores — product/offer/review/breadcrumb schema and image-alt coverage. Returns a weighted 0–100 score + top issues. Takes a `url`. This audits an arbitrary website by crawling it — for the user's OWN connected store with real analytics, use get_my_store_audit.

url.description: The website URL to audit, e.g. https://example.com

tools.name: full_seo_audit

tools.description: Get the user's OWN connected Shopify store audit — the deep 12-category report Inxy runs INSIDE the app using the store's real catalog, performance and analytics (technical, performance, on-page, schema, AEO, analytics, e-commerce, etc.) — far beyond what crawling a URL can see. Takes no url. Needs an Inxy API key (free at inxy.ai → Settings) + a connected store: pass the key either as `Authorization: Bearer inxy_sk_…` or as the `api_key` argument.

api_key.description: Your Inxy API key (inxy_sk_…). Optional if already sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.
